title: 95. LRU Cache

examples.explanation: Reads refresh recency; inserting keys 3 and 4 evicts keys 2 and 1 respectively.

hints: Combine a hash map for key lookup with a doubly linked recency list.
Move an existing key to the most-recent end after a successful `get` or an updating `put`.
When a new insertion exceeds capacity, remove the least-recent node from both the list and the map.
